what: A set of three photos changes every 4 seconds. The incoming photo flies into place from deep on the right (translate3d(100%,0,-1000px) · rotateX −15° · rotateY 80°, top-left pivot) in 1.4s cubic-bezier(.01,.89,.63,.99), and a 600%-size diagonal mask (only the center band dark) slides from 0% → 50% to reveal it in a band shape (second .3s later, third .1s later). To leave, the current one folds out deep to the left (−70% · −1500px · rotateY −90°) in 1.3s cubic-bezier(.56,.13,.89,.48), then 1.4s later the next one turns on. Over the board, a 110px blurred circle follows the cursor by 15% per frame and shows Next/Prev relative to the board center, and pressing moves in that direction

options.finish: Seconds from folding away until the next sheet turns on, default 1.4
options.lerp: Ratio at which the circle follows the cursor (per frame), default .15
options.drive: external means paging is done by the host (Splide etc.) and pressing the circle fires fx:next·fx:prev. The host adds is-active to the current slide and is-finished to the leaving one
options.--fx-delay-2 / --fx-delay-3: Second and third photo delay, default .3s · .1s
